name: Jon Tester
summary: Raymond Jon Tester (born August 21, 1956) is an American politician and farmer who served from 2007 to 2025 as a United States senator from Montana. A member of the Democratic Party, Tester served in the Montana Senate from 1999 to 2007, and as its president from 2005 to 2007. As of May  2025, he is a political analyst for MS NOW, and the most recent Democrat to have won or held statewide office in Montana.
